title: Bootstrapping black holes at low impact parameter
summary: We use the stringy dispersion relation (SDR) to ask the following question about gravitational effective field theories: once the universal large-impact-parameter eikonal carrier is supplied, where does the remaining positive spectrum go? Working in six dimensions for concreteness, we include the complete high-spin continuum tail of the carrier and first work at weak coupling, where $M_{\rm Pl}>M_{\rm EFT}$. The extremal spectra contain a saturated low-impact band whose outer edge stays at roughly five to six times the inverse EFT scale even as the gravitational radius shrinks. The same edge…
